description: This Java source file implements the DittoJwtAuthorizationSubjectsProvider class, which provides authorization subjects based on JWTs for the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for instantiation, retrieval of authorization subjects from a JSON Web Token, and overrides for equality, hash code, and toString.

classes.name: DittoJwtAuthorizationSubjectsProvider
classes.description: Provides authorization subjects configured for JWTs, specifically for Google JWTs, based on issuer information and configured subject issuer data.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DittoJwtAuthorizationSubjectsProvider with the given JwtSubjectIssuersConfig.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Extracts and returns a list of AuthorizationSubject objects from the provided JsonWebToken.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on jwtSubjectIssuersConfig.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on jwtSubjectIssuersConfig.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the provider object.
